candidate_semantics.cap_3: Use the current v83 recommendation unless its aggressive cost exceeds 3x the pot; then choose the highest v83 final-EV alternative whose aggressive cost is at most 3x pot (or a non-aggressive alternative).
candidate_semantics.cap_4: Use the current v83 recommendation unless its aggressive cost exceeds 4x the pot; then choose the highest v83 final-EV alternative whose aggressive cost is at most 4x pot (or a non-aggressive alternative).

invariants: Model A files and formulas are unchanged.
Model B v3 is an external validation environment and is not promoted by this strategy experiment.
Cards, profiles, runouts and seeds are paired across policies until trajectories diverge.
French PokerStars source histories are normalized textually to the equivalent English grammar accepted by frozen v83; cards, seats, amounts and action chronology are unchanged.
VALIDATION alone selects at most one finalist.
TEST is never inspected to select or retune a candidate.
No registry, production model, engine release or site pointer changes during candidate evaluation.
